text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer, multi-paragraph argument with an introduction, body sections, and conclusion","quality":"text organization","description":"The essay is more clearly structured into parts that build an argument from start to finish."},{"evidence":"“The first reason… The second reason… The third reason…”","quality":"logical sequencing","description":"It uses explicit numbering and transitions to guide the reader through its points."},{"evidence":"“The person who received the act of kindness might have bad a bad day or life”","quality":"sentence control","description":"Its sentences are more controlled and easier to follow, even when flawed, than the other essay’s frequent run-ons and fragments."},{"evidence":"extended explanations of how kindness affects someone’s day and behavior","quality":"development of ideas","description":"The essay develops its claims with fuller explanations instead of mostly repeating the same point."},{"evidence":"multiple concrete anecdotes about helping classmates and an old lady","quality":"elaboration with examples","description":"It supports its ideas with more specific examples that make the argument feel more grounded and complete."},{"evidence":"“you might have put a big smile on their face”","quality":"word choice","description":"It shows somewhat more precise and expressive vocabulary than the other essay’s simpler and more repetitive wording."}]}
